responsibility: Implements custom_edge_info support classes that describe nonstandard call outcomes attached to exploded-graph edges. It provides the shared call_info machinery for printing and path-event generation for bifurcated call outcomes, reconstructs call_details from stored edge metadata, and supplies the standard success/failure descriptive wording used by known-function models that split execution paths.
same_name_distinction: Implements the custom_edge_info and call_info behavior used after a call has been split into modeled outcomes, including printing, path-event creation, call_details reconstruction, and generic success/failure wording. Unlike call-info.h, it supplies the shared runtime behavior for these edge-metadata classes.
